title: 第5章 仙女上凡第6章 我为弟子
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
“师兄，你就发发慈悲，放过我们吧！”
身着白衣道袍，满头银丝的老人愁眉苦脸，对着一红衣少年不住的作揖道歉。
路过的人纷纷露出见怪不怪的表情，更有人轻叹一声道：“小师兄又欺负人啊？”
“人家是掌门亲传弟子，当之无愧的天之骄子，怎么能叫欺负人，那叫指点！”
有人摇摇头，小声道，“而且，我听说这位小师兄的脾气不大好……”
“知道我脾气不好还在我旁边叨叨？”
少年勃然大怒，“信不信小爷我让你们一起滚出北山宗！”
“沈云熠！”
眉眼如画，身姿挺拔如松的青衣男子轻喝道，“别牵连无辜的人。”
沈云熠嗤笑一声，抬起手指着对方的鼻子，正要开口，一道身影从天而降！
彩色的飘带迎风而动，撕开天际的流霞。
沈云熠眼眸中闪过一抹惊艳，双手一迎，怀里多了个人。
颜筝与突如其来的失重为伴，方才还在水中，一眨眼又出现在半空中。
眼前红衣少年眨眨灿若繁星的眼眸，鲜艳的红发带在风中转了几圈。
颜筝瞪大双眼，被接了个稳稳当当。
“你……？”
少年怔怔，风也静了，光也暖了。
颜筝耳鼓声轰鸣，她后知觉的反应过来，那是她的心跳。
“你是……”
颜筝刚开口，痛疼又一次卷袭，她的脸色刹时惨白一片。

幸好只是一点余痛，尚且在她承受范围内。
少年眨了眨眼，骤然喊道：“师兄师兄！”
“干什么？叫魂呐？”
青衣男人没好气的上前。
弟子们不约而同的让开一条道，显出几分郑重。
这位和沈云熠一样，都是掌门的亲传弟子，他们可惹不起。
他一路畅通无阻，低头凝望颜筝的眉眼，挑挑眉。
“师兄，她怎么了？”
“没什么，犯病了而已。”
青衣男子应了一声，眉心却略有几分拥挤。
“我是真的来找人的！
我找颜——”
颜筝的话还没谈完，人群一阵骚动，原本围做一团的弟子刹时退至两侧。
“吵什么吵！
你们有病啊！”
沈云熠一脸不耐，满腔怒火触及到来者时消失的无影无踪，“师尊？”
来者白发鹤颜，眼底两抹乌青，另有几根呆毛屹立在一旁，白袍衣角染了大半尘污，整个人看起来分外狼狈。
content_en:
"Brother, please show mercy and let us go!"
An old man wearing white robes and a head full of silver hair was frowning, and he kept bowing and apologizing to a young man in red.
People passing by had expressions of acknowledgment, and some even sighed softly: "Senior Brother, are you bullying others again?"
"I am a direct disciple of the sect leader and a well-deserved pride of heaven. How can I call it bullying? That's called giving advice!"
Someone shook his head and whispered, "Besides, I heard that this little senior brother has a bad temper..."
"You know I have a bad temper and you still nag me next to me?"
The young man was furious, "Believe it or not, I will tell you to get out of the Beishan Sect together!"
"Shen Yunyi!"
The man in green with picturesque features and a tall, pine-like figure shouted softly, "Don't implicate innocent people."
Shen Yunyi sneered, raised his finger and pointed at the other person's nose. Just as he was about to speak, a figure fell from the sky!
Colorful streamers moved in the wind, tearing apart the clouds in the sky.
A flash of surprise flashed in Chen Yunyi's eyes, and he greeted her with both hands, and there was someone else in his arms.
Yan Zheng was accompanied by the sudden weightlessness. He was still in the water just now, but he appeared in mid-air again in the blink of an eye.
The young man in red in front of him blinked his eyes as bright as stars, and his bright red hair ribbon twirled several times in the wind.
Yan Zheng's eyes widened as he was picked up steadily.
"You...?"
The young man was stunned, the wind became quieter, and the light became warmer.
Yan Zheng's eardrums roared, and she realized later that it was her heartbeat.
"You are..."
As soon as Yan Zheng opened her mouth, pain hit her again, and her face instantly turned pale.
Fortunately, there was only a little residual pain, which was within her tolerance range.
The young man blinked and suddenly shouted: "Senior brother, senior brother!"
"What are you doing? Calling the soul?"
The man in green came forward angrily.
The disciples unanimously moved out of the way, showing some solemnity.
Like Shen Yunyi, this person is a direct disciple of the sect leader, and they cannot afford to offend him.
He walked unimpeded, lowered his head and stared at Yan Zheng's eyebrows, raising his eyebrows.
"Brother, what happened to her?"
"It's nothing, I'm just sick."
The man in green responded, but his eyebrows were slightly crowded.
"I'm really here to find someone!
I’m looking for Yan——”
Before Yan Zheng could finish her words, the crowd started to commotion, and the disciples who were originally gathered in a group immediately retreated to both sides.
"What's the fuss about?
You are sick! "
Shen Yunyi had an impatient look on his face, filled with anger and disappeared without a trace when he touched the arrival, "Master?"
The visitor had white hair and a crane face, with two dark blue eyes, and a few dull hairs standing on the side. The corners of his white robe were mostly stained with dust, and the whole person looked extremely embarrassed.
